The '''Subla Ransom Medium Cargo Hauler''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Subla Ransom]]. The ''[[Zicreex]]'', commanded by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] sow [[Ugmush]], was one, as was the ''[[Efficient]]'', the personal transport of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[SCr-114|Scar]].
